description.value: CRAFT Beer Market sits right on Victoria Harbour, offering waterfront views from its surf lounge and an all-year patio. A full-service restaurant and bar with over 100 beers on tap, craft cocktails, and a sharing-style food menu, it is a lively chain destination known for its extensive draft selection and group-friendly spaces. Cyclists arriving at the Inner Harbour area will find it a substantial stop for a meal or post-ride drinks.

bike_parking_detail: 8 racks within 100m: rack at 26m; rack at 27m; stands (2 spaces) at 42m; stands (2 spaces) at 43m; stands (2 spaces) at 45m; stands (2 spaces) at 46m; rack (7 spaces) at 90m; rack (4 spaces) at 92m. Total: 19 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The corporate website confirms CRAFT Beer Market is a real, active multi-location chain, with Victoria specifically listed as an active venue ('Located right on Victoria Harbour, enjoy waterfront views from the surf lounge or all-year patio.'). The website navigation includes 'Order Take-Out', confirming takeout service. No evidence for bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, or most other amenities was present in the fetched website content, which is a high-level corporate page rather than a location-specific page.
concerns: The fetched website is a corporate multi-location page and does not display location-specific phone numbers or addresses, so the OSM phone and address could not be cross-checked against the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible restaurant and bar confirmed open at the Victoria Harbour location via the corporate website.
